title: docs(service-worker): render the SwPush and SwRegistrationOptions examples
body: The api-gen extractor only interpolates `{@example <path> region='<name>'}` (interpolate_code_examples.mts:79). `SwPush` uses the older `<code-example>` form and `SwRegistrationOptions` puts a `header` after `region=`, so neither is substituted: the SwPush page renders nothing where its three snippets should be, and SwRegistrationOptions prints the raw `{@example ...}` as text. Switch both to the supported form.
